stabpen.provenance.evidence_status: SIMULATION (sim2, MuJoCo 3.6; synthetic writers and tremor; Rev J PROPOSED DESIGN parameters). sim2 ranks concepts (context of use COU-1) until EXP-V01/V02/V04 calibrate and EXP-V05 validates it; not evidence of benefit to people

pen_source.label: CALCULATION on a PROPOSED DESIGN (Rev J integration, round 2); inputs from the round-1 studies (labelled) or ASSUMPTION; nothing built or measured (parameters for sim2)

what: Essential tremor with the Rev J pen (H1 hand, v2 writers, 'return library'), the test writers and seeds actually run are listed in 'coverage' (planned: writers 0-5, seeds 200-203); tremor 4/8/12 Hz x 0.3/1/2 mm (stabpen tremor model)

labels.ink_err_um: SIM: rms distance of the in-contact ink to the writer's clean-ink letters (letter-wise nearest point)
labels.ratio: SIM: ink error / ink error of the device-off pen in the same case
labels.letters_read: SIM: share of letters the app's recogniser reads as the intended letter
labels.words_app: SIM: share of words the app reads correctly after its autocorrect
labels.device_share: SIM: share of the ink motion that comes from the device (authorship)
labels.felt_rms_N: SIM: rms change of the grip force on the hand against the device-off run
labels.P_total_W: CALC on SIM: mean electrical power incl. 0.077 W electronics
labels.moved_vs_clean_um: SIM: false correction, rms ink moved on tremor-free writing against the device-off pen with the same seed (rule <= 25 um)
